name: Grand Slam of Cubing: Lloydminster 2025

venue.name: [Lloydminster Golf and Curling Centre](https://www.lloydminster.ca/recreation-culture-community/wwwlgccca/events/)
venue.details: Upstairs at the Green Glacier Eatery

information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png)

Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers should be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

**Unofficial Event:**
We will be hosting 1 round of Mirror Blocks during lunch. Please see the tab for more information.

**Draw prizes:** 
There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Post-Comp Curling Ice and Social:** 
We will have 2 sheets of ice booked at the Lloydminster Curling Club downstairs, from 5PM til 7PM after cubing. This will be free to attend for any competitors and their families. You will be able to borrow all equipment, but you will need a clean pair of shoes. We encourage you to stick around, have fun, try something new, and the venue upstairs will stay open as well. This is a great way to make friends in the community.

**Guests**
Please let us know in your registration comment how many guests you will be bringing so we can plan seating accordingly. There is no guest limit at this venue as it is large and has extra areas for overflow seating.

**Notice of Filming and Photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
